what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Chile in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 13744 Chilean asylum seekers in the United States, 59.6% of all asylum seekers from Chile.
Refugees from Chile, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, Mexico, Sweden and Spain.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Chile, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 42 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
